CPU_execution: CPU tensors only; Torch threads fixed to1 within check process; no CUDA API, graph libraries, models, optimizer, link pools or metrics
admission: Root exact-source approval, script/public-input manifest hashes and authenticated available inspector receipt are required
literal_exporter_origin_on_match: Unknown; exact equality may qualify available feature semantics through root review
mismatch_policy: Preserve both prospectively named comparison results; no transforms, reordering, tolerance tuning, donor substitution or automatic feature-authority adoption
population_shape_guard: At most19717 rows per raw sparse matrix,500 columns; concatenation must have exactly19717 rows and index must permute the appended suffix
public_authentication: Immutable commit URLs; byte size and Git blob SHA1 verified before restricted unpickle, plus new SHA256 scalar receipt
raw_pickle_policy: Allow only SciPy CSR class and NumPy ndarray/dtype/reconstruct/scalar storage globals with latin1 compatibility; unknown globals fail; no unrestricted pickle fallback
scalar_outputs: Source/input identities, shapes, native ordering, equality value/bit booleans, mismatch counts, maximum absolute differences, dense reference digest, versions, elapsed time; no node arrays exported
